items.headline: No. 22 Boise State hosts Utah State in Pac-12 play
items.description: Utah State (1-3) at No. 22 Boise State (3-1), Oct. 3 at 7:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Grady Brosterhous throws for 242 yards and 2 TDs to help Utah State beat Troy 21-10
items.description: — Grady Brosterhous threw for 242 yards and two touchdowns and rushed for 89 yards as Utah State scored 14 unanswered points in the second half to beat Troy 21-10 on Saturday.

items.headline: Devon Dampier throws 2 TD passes, Daniel Bray adds TD run as No. 17 Utah beats Utah State 33-0
items.description: — Devon Dampier threw for 253 yards and two touchdowns, leading No. 17 Utah to a 33-0 victory over Utah State on Saturday.

items.headline: Utah State LB Taggart exits loss in ambulance after tackle
items.description: Utah State linebacker Harrison Taggart was taken off the field in an ambulance after an injury while making a tackle in the second quarter of Saturday's 33-0 loss to No. 17 Utah, and program officials said he was in concussion protocol with a neck injury.
